implementation: The existing iterative parameter resolver uses lexical scope identities for caches, cycles and dependency execution, retaining existing single-context callers.

The ordered analysis plan retains only pending-card scopes and their ancestors. Closed environments move into private completion storage; original subcircuit body/default expressions remain unchanged for instance elaboration.
Incomplete inherited bindings complete from their parents without eagerly evaluating unused body parameters. Known numeric/string snapshots and local definitions keep precedence.

A private parser token wrapper allocates operand state only during scoped completion. Prepared numeric programs suspend at missing dependencies and resume without replaying completed operands, lazy conditions or random draws.

Probe environments preserve sharing between random streams and distinct explicit reseeds, while isolating live counters. Successful graph values materialize into their owning retained scopes for reuse by subsequent cards.

Existing ordered grammar validation, output/diagnostic merging, MC bytes/spans and LIN/noise constraints remain authoritative. Cancellation is polled while preparing ancestry, resolving graphs, retrying grammar and publishing effects.
acceptance_evidence: Twenty-six numeric analysis/auxiliary families in both expression dialects match literal grammar through root and subcircuit retained-parameter chains.
Bare and signed operands bind later local declarations, unresolved header defaults, later parent declarations and later root declarations.
A public DC resistor-divider oracle retains gain=3 instance overrides after analysis binding; unused instance-dependent body definitions are not eagerly forced by parsing.
Nested/sibling/parent reads reuse one owning-scope sample. Child base overrides do not change the parent dependency; previously inherited numeric values are not replaced by a later parent cache.
Complex values, known function definitions and lazy branches preserve authored bindings. Random conditions and earlier numeric fields are not replayed while later operands suspend.
Root cards reject child-only bindings; sibling definitions remain isolated. Included scoped DC errors and FFT warnings retain physical paths and lines.

Failed or cancelled scoped completion publishes no partial analysis/output effects and consumes no live probe draws. Existing root transaction, identity, control, temperature and source/model regressions remain active.
limits: Forward TEMP/TNOM options still resolve at .ENDS and need parent completion when enclosing declarations arrive later. Ngspice provisional-temperature domain errors remain open.
Typed AnalysisCardError still carries a line without an include path; ordinary value-error and diagnostic source ownership is covered here.
Per-card captures and retained ancestry have not received complete allocation, peak-memory or throughput qualification. Cancellation inside compilation/classification remains open.
Grammar agreement does not independently qualify every periodic/noise/mixed-signal solver. The numerical oracle here is the stated public divider route.
All C00-C14 packages remain unfinished. Control dispatch remains 5/29; table control/document/adapter integration and general statistical/runtime qualification remain open.
Three existing unit tests remain ignored. Selected native and optimized Chrome-worker configurations do not cover every feature/provider/platform.
development_notes: Initial scoped and broad development selections passed. Review then identified a potential owner-cache collision with an inherited numeric child snapshot; materialized bindings now remain in their snapshot scope and a public regression checks the mixed dependency. Final qualification was rerun on the committed implementation, including that correction.
